old_problem: Pending values were both connector paths, loading mode/profile, low-rail tolerances and per-port error limits.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits runtime path/profile bindings, ED-09 keeps physical/chamber work manual, ED-14 preserves 12 hours, ED-15 requires signed per-port limits, and ED-17 preserves baseline evidence.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row52 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3088 and actual next pending row55/history3089 were read.

test_case.test_name: Both front USB2 ports 12-hour stress at 0C/-5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify front USB2 slots1-2 each sustain the approved load at cold/low-rail margin without data error, reconnect, shared-hub reset or platform event.
required_package: Pinned dual-port SST profile and integrity volume
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/-5% conditions, verify both mapped tools, run the approved simultaneous-or-sequential SST profile for 12 hours with per-port integrity/reset telemetry, then warm dry and restore nominal rails.
test_case.expected_result: Both named ports complete their required coverage with no data mismatch or disallowed reconnect/reset/controller/kernel/SEL event and healthy restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires connector-specific evidence for both ports and full duration; one port, aggregate success or a retried reset cannot pass.
safety_gate: Calibrated low-rail ramp and undershoot limit
Abort on condensation, shared-hub instability, mismatch, electrical or thermal fault
Preserve logs; no auto-retry; dry warm-up
test_case.recovery: Stop on a limit, preserve both ports' evidence, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, recover the approved topology and do not auto-retry.

source_conflict.reason: Sources consistently require both front USB2 ports.
